manager.title: Workspace Manager
manager.description: Workspaces organize your own collections and environments. Use Teams to share them with a group.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Create teams to share collections and environments with a group of people at once. Teams are visible to everyone in this workspace — only admins can edit a team's roster. In a workspace shared with a team, admins can also edit the contents.

form.shareHint: Team members see this workspace and everything in it: team admins get Editor access to its collections, environments, whiteboards and notes, members can only view them.

delete.workspaceDescription: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
delete.teamDescription: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? Any collection / environment grants pointing at this team will become inactive (the resources stay accessible to their owners and individual collaborators).
